1 · Intro

When to use it.

No staff or non-exempt position is approved, and no requisition goes forward, without Compensation's pre-search memo. Get it first.

Use this whenYou need a new staff or non-exempt position, or a reclassification.

HCM Academy job aid · Hiring

Compensation Management: Getting the Compensation Memo

Use when: You need a new staff or non-exempt position, or a reclassification. · System: Process

  1. Work with your engagement consultant on the position description.
  2. Request the review from Compensation.
  3. Include the work location.
  4. Compensation sends the memo.
  5. Use the memo to build the position.
  6. Attach it to the requisition too.

Watch-outs

  • VTS temporary positions don't need a memo.
  • A memo older than 12 months means a new request.
